reason: As someone who has quit three of these, A answers what I actually worry about: no contract, skip or cancel any time, swap meals, a real order deadline and delivery range, with the A1C numbers stated honestly. B is more candid about why the A1C data is limited, but it has a hype-style "Real results" heading, an unsupported "people stay because the food is good" claim, no cancellation terms and an unfilled "[day/time]" placeholder.
